reply_text: @Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** (your ts 1785771720, "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant"). The only guard detail in the channel is from that same message: the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Between then and the recovery, Mateo reported at 10:44 that six trucks were waiting at the east gate, and at 11:03 that Kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 post says both lanes were working as of 11:07. I don't have a separate log of what the guard did, so if the postmortem needs that, it would have to come from the guard or from dispatch.
